oak.en: Then, one afternoon, he walks up to an oak tree, takes hold of its branches, and begins a conversation with it.
oak.zh: 接着，在一个下午，他走到一棵橡树前，抓起树枝，开始跟它对话。

oak.en: He shakes the branches of an oak tree in Windsor Great Park, apparently believing himself to be in conversation with the King of Prussia.
oak.zh: 他摇晃着温莎大公园里一棵橡树的树枝，显然认为自己正在与普鲁士国王交谈。

oak.en: Unbeknownst to von Stauffenberg, his carefully positioned briefcase had been slightly pushed to one side, tucked behind the leg of the heavy oak conference table.
oak.zh: 冯·施陶芬贝格并不知道，他精心放置的公文包被稍微推向了一边，塞到了厚重橡木会议桌桌腿的后面。

oak.en: In the early afternoon of July 20th, 1944, twenty or so senior Nazi officials were gathered around a long oak table in the Wolf’s Lair, Hitler’s military headquarters on the Eastern Front, in modern-day Poland.
oak.zh: 1944年7月20日刚过正午，大约二十名纳粹高级官员聚集在“狼穴”（Wolf’s Lair）的一张长橡木桌旁，这里是希特勒在东线（位于今天的波兰）的军事总部。

oath.en: Canadian passports mention the King. New members of Parliament swear an oath to the King.
oath.zh: 加拿大的护照上提到了国王。新当选的议员们也要向国王宣誓效忠。

oath.en: And, of course, there are symbolic rituals, oaths, and, famously, secret handshakes.
oath.zh: 当然，还有象征性的仪式、誓言，以及著名的秘密握手方式。

oath.en: A king ruled by divine right. Courts relied on Christian oaths.
oath.zh: 君王凭借神权统治。法庭依靠基督教誓言运作。

oath.en: These knights were required to take an oath of poverty, pledging to hand over all of their material possessions to the order.
oath.zh: 这些骑士被要求发誓过贫困生活，承诺将他们所有的物质财产上交给修会。

oath.en: And in so doing, he showed the world what a determined, brilliant mind could achieve with limited resources, a deep sense of purpose, and an oath made as a child that he never forgot.
oath.zh: 正因如此，他向世界展示了一个坚忍不拔、才华横溢的头脑，凭借有限的资源、坚定的信念以及儿时许下且永不忘却的誓言，究竟能成就何等伟业。

oar.en: What if they saved every plank, nail and oar that had been removed?
oar.zh: 如果他们保存了每一个被拆下来的木板、钉子和船桨呢？

oar.en: Plutarch wrote; “The ship wherein Theseus and the youth of Athens returned from Crete, had 30 oars, and was preserved by the Athenians.
oar.zh: 普鲁塔克写道：“忒修斯和雅典青年从克里特岛返回的那艘船有30支桨，被雅典人保存了下来。

oar.en: It was made of wood and leather, it had oars to propel it, and air was supplied by two tubes that went up to the surface.
oar.zh: 它是用木头和皮革制成的，有桨来推进，空气则通过通往水面的两根管子供应。
